provenance.method: Canada federal-orientation Question with explicit provincial/territorial handoff.

question: How do I start looking into an autism assessment in Canada?
why_it_matters: Canada-wide health information can orient a reader, but provinces and territories deliver health services differently.
current_understanding: The Government of Canada advises speaking with a healthcare provider about assessment concerns and notes that specialists may be involved. Use this only as national orientation; the practical access route depends on the relevant province or territory. ND Oracle does not diagnose autism.
evidence_needed: Province/territory assessment routes selected by real user need rather than placeholder coverage.
reopening_conditions: Federal assessment information changes or additional provincial packages are accepted.
dissent: A federal orientation route can be useful even though it deliberately cannot answer local wait-time or service-access questions.
